$comment: Host contract (AgnesCode/goose, crates/goose/src/hooks/mod.rs): command runs under sh -c.
The host replaces ${PLUGIN_ROOT} with this plugin root. matcher is an unanchored regex on the tool name.
The matcher covers goose names (developer__shell / developer__write / agnes_web_search__WebSearch)
and Claude names (Bash / Write / WebSearch). pretool.py decides by capability.

hooks.command: PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -z "$PY" ]; then PY='py -3'; fi; exec $PY "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretool.py"
